quarterly_data.signal: Marc Dunoyer (CEO of Alexion, Chief Strategy Officer of AstraZeneca) at the ASBMR meet-the-management event on efzimfotase alfa in hypophosphatasia (HPP): the peak-year sales expectation of $3 billion-$5 billion, first given in May 2024, is confirmed - within that range regardless of label breadth, towards $3 billion if the label is more restrictive than hoped and closer to $5 billion with a wider label; the range is consistent with between 4 and 6 times the 2022 baseline number of patients. He expects conversion from Strensiq to be very rapid, with growth from Strensiq switching, treatment-naive patients and regional expansion (Strensiq is progressively gaining reimbursement and approvals around the world). Available data suggest approximately 14,000 addressable patients across the top 8 markets (20% pediatric, 60% adults with pediatric-onset disease, 20% adults with adult-onset disease; approximately 43% with skeletal manifestations). Every-two-weeks weight-banded dosing means approximately 12 times fewer injections per year than Strensiq; 80% of injection site reactions resolved before the next injection, with four times fewer persisting beyond 28 days than Strensiq; abandonment of Strensiq in adults due to injection site reactions is estimated at 40%. More development work on efzimfotase alfa is planned, including post-approval.

quarterly_data.signal: Gianluca Pirozzi (Head of Development, Rare Disease, and Safety, Alexion): efzimfotase alfa is filed in major geographies and under review, and the FDA priority review was assigned to the totality of the dataset - pediatric patients, adults with pediatric onset and adults with adult onset. The phase III program enrolled 196 patients across 22 countries (the largest clinical program in HPP to date, company claim). He attributed the HICKORY primary-endpoint miss to the adult-onset group, which saw higher-than-expected Six-Minute Walk Test improvement (28 meters against the 10 meters in adults with pediatric onset), driven by a couple of adult-onset placebo patients with unusual improvements in the range of 200, an older population (mean age 54) with more comorbidities and assisting devices, and a placebo arm starting 50 meters lower at baseline; adult-onset patients showed a fatigue improvement of 7 points. Pediatric bone efficacy is generally similar to Strensiq at a much lower dose and injection frequency, and additional dosing regimens may be assessed in future. Efzimfotase alfa's mean half-life is around 6 days, and an optimized manufacturing process improves production efficiency and reduces wastage.
quarterly_data.figure: 196 patients across 22 countries; FDA priority review covers the full dataset including adult onset; adult-onset placebo outliers in the range of 200; placebo baseline 50 meters lower; adult-onset fatigue improvement of 7 points; half-life around 6 days
